description.zh:
购买时长，转成包年包月类型时需要传入。

- PricingCycle为Month时，取值范围为\[1,9\]。

- PricingCycle为Year时，取值范围为\[1,3\]。
description.en:
The subscription duration. This parameter is required when you change the billing method to subscription.

- If \`PricingCycle\` is \`Month\`, the valid values are 1 to 9.

- If \`PricingCycle\` is \`Year\`, the valid values are 1 to 3.

description.zh:
实例的付费类型，返回：

- **PREPAY**：包年包月。
- **POSTPAY**：按量付费。
description.en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- **PREPAY**: subscription.

- **POSTPAY**: pay-as-you-go.

description.zh:
转成包年包月类型时的购买时长单位。

- Month：月。

- Year：年。
description.en:
The unit of the subscription duration. This parameter is required when you change the billing method to subscription.

- Month: The unit is month.

- Year: The unit is year.

descriptions.zh:
调整实例的付费类型，支持包年包月与按量付费类型之间进行切换。

请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解Lindorm产品的收费方式和<props="china">[价格](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.6345281fu63xJ3#/hitsdb/detail/hitsdb_lindormpre_public_cn)。只发布国内站</props>
<props="intl">[价格](https://www.alibabacloud.com/zh/pricing-calculator?_p_lc=1&spm=a2796.7960336.3034855210.1.7396b91aC5VjZ7#/commodity/vm_intl)。只发布国际站</props>
descriptions.en:
Switches the billing method of an instance between subscription and pay-as-you-go.

Before you call this operation, make sure that you understand the billing methods and <props="china">[pricing](https://www.aliyun.com/price/product?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.6345281fu63xJ3#/hitsdb/detail/hitsdb_lindormpre_public_cn)</props>
<props="intl">[pricing](https://www.alibabacloud.com/zh/pricing-calculator?_p_lc=1\&spm=a2796.7960336.3034855210.1.7396b91aC5VjZ7#/commodity/vm_intl)</props> of Lindorm.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hitsdb modify-instance-pay-type --instance-id ld-bp1z3506imz2f0000 --duration 1 --pricing-cycle Month --pay-type POSTPAY --api-version 2020-06-15 --region cn-hangzhou
